title: LORD GIVE ME ALSO SPRINGS OF WATER

lines.text: Lord give me also springs of water (3)
Lord, let the desert blossom as a rose,
We see the harvest field shining in the sun,
O Lord together let us overflow,
Lord, let Your people be glad
Lord, let the world know that you are alive,

chords:
[Verse 1]
[E]Lord give me also springs of water (3)
That I may overflow (2)
Lord, let the [E]desert blossom as a rose,
Lord, let the [A]wilderness rejoice !

[Verse 2]
We see the [E]harvest field shining in the sun,
Lord, let [B]me overflow. (2)
O Lord together [E]let us overflow,
Lord, let Your [A]people be glad

[Verse 3]
Lord, let the [E]world know that you are alive,
Lord, let the [B]river overflow. (2)
[E]Hallelujah! Hallelujah !
[A]Hallelujah! Hallelu.

[Verse 4]
[E]Halelujah! Hallelujah !
Lord, let me overflow. (2)
